## Changed

- **Streaming does less work per message.** The streaming reader hashes contract ids with a faster hasher, looks each message's contract and delta baseline up once instead of two and three times, and reads the wall clock once per message instead of twice. On the reader-thread benchmark added in [#1501](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/pull/1501) it decodes about 1.4 times as many messages a second as 0.8.1: 5.0M against 3.5M on a c3-standard-8, pinned to two cores. Events, their order and their fields are unchanged.

There are no API changes from 0.8.1.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/blob/v0.8.2/CHANGELOG.md) for the details.
